description: A Backbone.js model definition for Drupal's toolbar component, including default properties, validation logic, and encapsulation within an IIFE.

classes.name: Drupal.toolbar.ToolbarModel
classes.description: A Backbone model representing the state and behavior of the Drupal toolbar, including properties like activeTab, orientation, and methods for validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the model's attributes, specifically preventing setting the orientation to horizontal if the toolbar is locked, unless overridden.
